title: ProjectBundleStepEntry
description: A single step in the CAGE governance DAG. Maps 1:1 to a LangGraph node execution snapshot. The parentStepIds field captures DAG edges from preceding nodes.

stepId.description: Unique identifier for this step (UUID v4)

parentStepIds.description: Step IDs of all parent nodes in the DAG. Empty for entry nodes.

timestampUtc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this step was executed

signals.description: Governance signals emitted by this node (CBF verdicts, OPA decisions, etc.). Open extension point for domain-specific data.

metadata.description: Arbitrary node metadata (model names, token counts, etc.). Open extension point.

stateHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the serialized AgentState snapshot at this node
